summary: Import locally configured MCP servers and pinned GitHub implementations as native versioned URI packages under mcp/

delivery.outcome: Discover all local MCP configurations; build versioned process packages and native registry catalogs under mcp; invoke real tools through Taskand URI with pinned schemas and bounded SDK transport.
nonGoals: Autonomous tool admission or arbitrary tool execution

architecture.decision: Native process package projection from official MCP tools/list with a reusable SDK bridge. Treat local MCP configs as trusted operator inputs, keep host profiles private, pin tool schemas and source versions; register mcp root through existing registry semantics. Generated per-tool packages are deployment artifacts, produced in an isolated release and never counted as handwritten source. Existing ticket029 controller remains an independent optional dashboard; this slice uses native gateway URI grants.
interfaceChanges: native URI resolution in mcp root
dataChanges: Candidate MCP process registry under mcp in deployment
architecture.rollback: Stop only the isolated integration pilot and retain its profiles and receipts; original gateways remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: Real stdio and HTTP tool discovery, schema pinning, error and boundary tests
Native URI round trip in isolated release and managed repository gates
